notes: Pre-seed co-investors: Carbon Silicon, Everywhere Ventures, and angels Sonia Arrison (Foresight Institute) and Eduardo Torrealba (Formlabs). Entrepreneur First backed the founders (EF lists founding as 2024).

Conflicting: StartupIntros lists a USD 3M seed in April 2024 and USD 5.7M total; VC Backed dates the pre-seed to April 2024. Neither is corroborated, so only the 2024-11-19 USD 2.7M round is recorded. No Form D was found in EDGAR full-text search for 'Tetsuwan'.
Openings: 2 on Ashby (board 'tetsuwan'), both published 2026-06-03. 'Product Designer' is counted under software-eng.
Not done (time and Wayback budget): team-page or LinkedIn headcount via Wayback, posting history, OpenAlex. No headcount datapoint was found. Bio-lab focused, not materials.
